handoffPurpose: Allow a new Codex session or a different AI account to maintain the project without losing operational context.

notes: Use npm run cf:deploy for production deployment.
After deploy, verify the production URL responds with HTTP 200.
The app intentionally uses the pages.dev URL unless a custom domain is added later.

mustDo: Run npm test and npm run build after business logic changes.
Keep production DB changes targeted and review SELECT results before UPDATE or DELETE.
Commit and push production-relevant code changes to main when the user asks for GitHub sync.
mustNotDo: Do not reset or recreate the production D1 database without explicit approval.
Do not commit secrets, cookies, local temp files, or credentials.
Do not commit .tmp-* files, .claude/, .wrangler/, or real env files.
Do not use destructive Git commands such as git reset --hard unless explicitly requested.

loginRateLimit.reason: User requested removal; login attempts no longer lock or throttle accounts.

passwordFeatures: Admin/Director can reset employee passwords from employee edit.

approvalRules.finalApprovedCancel: Admin/Director and final approver logic exists in the approval route.

underOneYear.unpaidLeaveEffect: UNPAID leave overlapping a monthly accrual period blocks that month's monthly leave.

oneYearOrMore.rule: 15 days on work anniversary, +1 day every 2 years, max 25

leavePolicy.displayNote: SICK is a legacy enum currently used/displayed as public or official leave.

adminLeaveAdjustment.uiMeaning: Employee edit form leave field means target final remaining leave.
adminLeaveAdjustment.mobileNegativeInput: Use text input with decimal inputMode, not input type=number, so mobile keyboards can enter negative values.

knownHistoricalCaveat.summary: A historical screen showed entitlement 17.0, used 0.0, pending 0.0, but remaining 1.0 for one employee.
knownHistoricalCaveat.currentStatus: Current DB state could not reproduce the issue.
knownHistoricalCaveat.confirmedCurrentState: For WB-0014, leave_adjustment_days was 0 and there were no leave_requests at the time of investigation.
knownHistoricalCaveat.limitation: Old adjustment logs were missing because the log write function had existed but was not called. The code now writes adjustment logs.

recentImportantChanges: KST date-boundary calculation was fixed in functions/lib/leave.ts.
Admin/Director employee cards show remaining leave and calculation basis.
Employee edit leave input now targets final remaining leave rather than raw adjustment.
Leave adjustment logs are written when adjustment changes.
Login rate limiting was intentionally removed.
Mobile negative leave input was fixed.
recommendedNewCodexWorkflow: Deploy with npm run cf:deploy only when requested or clearly needed.
Commit and push to main when the user asks for GitHub sync.
